newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil telecom firms maintained.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil telecom firms maintained.

text.p: -- Banco Patrimonio-Salomon Brothers said it was maintaining its buy rating on Brazil's Telesp and Telemig TMG_p.SA preferred shares.
-- It also said it reiterated its hold recommendation for Telesp and Telemig's common shares.
-- Telesp and Telemig are units of federally-owned telecommunications firm Telebras serving Sao Paulo and Minas Gerais states, respectively.
-- The bank also said it was maintaining its hold rating on Telerj, Telebras' unit serving Rio de Janeiro state.
-- Telesp, Telemig and Telerj preferred stocks traded at 294 reais, 101.50 reais and 156 reais, respectively, in late afternoon on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
